reading: Christiane Amanpour is a famous journalist for CNN.
She will leave the news network next year.
Amanpour has worked there for 43 years.
She started her job in 1983 as an assistant.
Later, she became a famous correspondent reporting on wars.
Now, the 68-year-old journalist wants to try new projects.
A leader at CNN thanked her for her great work.

vocabulary.definition: A person who collects and reports the news.
A large television or radio company.
To go away from a job or a place.
A person who helps someone else do their job.
Big, violent fights between different countries or groups.
Special tasks or new activities to work on.
